name: whatsappcrm
description: Multi-tenant, white-label WhatsApp CRM + helpdesk platform

scripts.db:roles: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U whatsappcrm -d whatsappcrm -f /sql/app-roles.sql
scripts.db:roles:login: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U whatsappcrm -d whatsappcrm -v password=local_dev_only -f /sql/app-roles-login.sql
scripts.db:roles:down: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U whatsappcrm -d whatsappcrm -f /sql/app-roles-down.sql
scripts.db:verify:rls: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U whatsappcrm -d whatsappcrm -f /sql/verify-tenant-isolation.sql
scripts.test:db: turbo run build --filter=./packages/* && pnpm --filter @whatsappcrm/api run test:db
